scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent successfully used required opening and closing branding scripts.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent maintained active communication without excessive dead air (>30s).

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent verified customer identity within the required time window.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent addressed customer by their verified name during the interaction.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Use phrases that acknowledge and validate the customer's feelings, such as 'I understand why you'd feel frustrated with this issue'.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent accurately acknowledged and mirrored the customer's reported issue.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent practiced active listening without repetitive or redundant questions.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent demonstrated clear ownership without deflecting or blaming other departments.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Maintain a professional tone and actively listen to the customer to build trust and establish a positive relationship.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask open-ended questions to gather more information about the issue and clarify any doubts, such as 'Can you tell me more about what happened?' or 'How did this affect your experience?'

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Explicitly confirm with the customer that their issue has been resolved by saying something like 'Is there anything else I can assist you with now that we've fixed the problem?'
